deployments_detail.use: In-house IT arm En+ Digital delivering machine learning and analytics for production systems
AI predictive equipment maintenance and aluminium ingot quality assessment (RUSAL/En+)

Machine vision + neural network system monitoring aluminium melt/alloy preparation in the casthouse, tracking operator actions across 7-20 sequential operations to reduce human error and defects. Deployed at Taishet Aluminium Smelter (TaAZ), with rollout planned to all smelters. [RUSAL Engineering and Technology Centre (RUSAL ETC), proprietary]

Machine vision + eight dedicated neural networks for microstructure quality analysis of cylindrical aluminium ingots (grain size, inclusions across 8 parameters). Operational at the RUSAL Engineering Center laboratory, cutting analysis time from up to 4 hours to 15 minutes. [RUSAL Engineering Center, proprietary neural networks]
deployments_detail.value: Analysis time reduced from up to 4 hours (90 min-4 hr) to 15 minutes

deployments_detail.use: Machine vision technology monitoring electrolysis workshops (EcoSoderberg cells) at five aluminium smelters — Krasnoyarsk, Bratsk, Novokuznetsk, Irkutsk and Volgograd — for real-time equipment and process oversight. Rollout through 2027. [RUSAL, proprietary]

Neural-network model for electrolysis process control on RA-550 electrolysers at Sayanogorsk Aluminium Smelter: calculates electrolyte chemical composition from temperature, current, voltage and adjusts the process with minimal human input. Completed industrial tests; moving to implementation across smelters. [RUSAL, proprietary neural network]

Machine hearing (acoustic AI) technology controlling mill loading in alumina production: analyzes acoustic vibrations from wet grinding to optimize bauxite ore input, prevent under/overloading, reduce equipment wear and power consumption. Tested at Krasnoturinsk Alumina Plant; evaluating Achinsk Alumina Refinery. [RUSAL, proprietary (machine hearing)]

ELTM (Electrolysis Technology Monitoring) — AI/neural network integrated into the automatic electrolysis monitoring system across all aluminium plants, processing 85 parameters per electrolyser (~600,000 parameters across all plants) to prioritize alerts by urgency and recommend corrective actions for deviations. [RUSAL Engineering and Technology Center (RUSAL ITC), proprietary]
deployments_detail.value: Processes ~600,000 parameters (85 per electrolyser) across all plants

deployments_detail.use: Proprietary software automating control of anode baking furnaces (burners and furnace systems) at Sayanogorsk Aluminium Smelter, with architecture explicitly built to support neural-network-based approaches for furnace management and optimisation. The furnace automation software is deployed; the neural-network optimization layer is on the roadmap. [RUSAL Engineering Department, proprietary]
deployments_detail.value: ~$200 million modernization; baked-anode capacity up from 480,000 to 535,000 tonnes/yr

deployments_detail.use: AI + machine vision container terminal control at Krasnoyarsk Aluminium Smelter (KrAZ): more than ten machine-learning models create a virtual twin of the terminal, recognize container numbers and track real-time locations via cameras and GPS sensors on loaders. Won ComNews 'Best Digital Logistics Solution' award. [RUSAL, proprietary (10+ ML models)]
deployments_detail.value: Goal to increase container shipments by 60% within two years; container location time cut from ~30 minutes
